title: Not-So-Optimal Transport Flows for 3D Point Cloud Generation
tldr_zh: 证明 equivariant OT 在大点云上算不动且完全 OT 耦合让 t≈0 处场难学，提出离线 superset OT + 混合耦合，少步数生成优于基线
tldr_en: Shows equivariant OT scales poorly on large point clouds and full OT coupling makes t≈0 vector field hard to learn; proposes offline superset OT + hybrid coupling for few-step generation
